questions.question_text: $A$ is the point $(5,-2)$ and $\overrightarrow{AB}=\begin{pmatrix}-3\\7\end{pmatrix}$. What are the coordinates of $B$?

options.why: Subtracted the vector from $A$ instead of adding it, which finds a point on the wrong side of $A$.
Swapped the two components of the vector before adding them to $A$.
Subtracted $A$ from the vector rather than adding the vector to $A$.

questions.solution_text:
$\overrightarrow{AB}$ is the step from $A$ to $B$, so add it to $A$.
$B=(5+(-3),\ -2+7)$
$=(2,5)$
